name: agent_spawned first spawn creates entity and increments agentCount
agent_spawned without taskId uses agentId as key
turn_ended accumulates inputTokens/outputTokens and adds text/thinking log entries
tool_call_started increments toolCallCount and tool_call_ended appends log
log cap at 500 drops oldest entries when log exceeds 500
task lifecycle: registered → started → step_started → completed transitions status correctly
task_registered creates entity with steps and updates phase taskIds
phase_registered builds phases array in insertion order
sidebar_updated patches title and indicator (no phases)
workflow_failed sets status to failed with error and failedPhase
phase lifecycle: currentPhaseId tracks latest, completedPhaseIds accumulates
agent_completed marks agent inactive with completedAt
